completion_test: Attributable source provides revenue split by named customer/platform and period, or direct company/customer/supplier confirmation explicitly states unavailable at the requested granularity.

common_questions: Can the company disclose revenue by named customer or platform for the requested periods?
If named customer disclosure is not permitted, can the company disclose the highest approved granularity, such as GPU / ASIC / domestic compute / optical-module / switch / AI server buckets?
Can the company confirm whether revenue is already included in reported segment/application categories and identify the relevant category?
Can the company provide certification, batch-supply, order backlog, ASP, shipment, gross margin or product-generation mix by platform bucket?
If none of the above can be disclosed, can the company explicitly confirm the disclosure boundary?
boundary: This confirmation pack is a request and evidence-boundary artifact. It does not itself satisfy the named platform/customer revenue split requirement.
